new.nsLocalhost: localhost serves the zone to nobody: give the real name servers

detail.staticNote: Static zone: record changes edit its zone file (comments kept, serial bumped, rndc reload with NOTIFY). Converting it to dynamic is a security audit remediation: named then keeps changes in a .jnl journal and the file is edited by hand only between rndc freeze and rndc thaw.
detail.notEditable: Defined in a user file: edit it in named.conf
detail.deleteMessage: The zone is removed from this node through a plan you review before it applies.
detail.deletePeers: Also remove the secondary copies on {{nodes}}
detail.deletePeersHelp: Left in place, they keep retrying transfers from a primary that no longer serves the zone.

secondaries.title: Secondary nodes
secondaries.hint: Ticked nodes transfer the zone from the primary with the read key; the primary notifies each of them. Unticked copies are removed.
